summary: One row of a list the reader scans by name and opens to act on.
not_for: A list the reader compares by property: that is collection.table.index.

slots.when: The image helps the reader pick the one record; leave it out otherwise.

slots.label_form: {label}：{value} when the value alone is ambiguous

slots.when: Only when the row has no single view to open.

rules.rule: The whole row is a link to the record's single view, and holds no other link or button.
Every row shows the same kinds of property, in the same order.
The property the reader sorted or filtered by is shown in the row.
The properties are ranked by what the reader identifies or decides by, highest first.
The first words of the name carry the information.

labels.empty_filtered: 該当する{object}はありません。

evidence.source: SmartHR Design System, よくあるリスト
evidence.says: The object name is required to identify each object; every item shows the same kinds and number of fields; a row without a detail page takes one icon button or one menu.
A resource item is the object's name with its key details, and the whole item opens the object.

evidence.source: デジタル庁デザインシステム, リソースリスト
evidence.says: A resource list item links to its detail and holds no other control when the whole item is the link.
Order a list entry's attributes by the user's priority; the top and left carry the highest.

evidence.source: Baymard Institute, Contextual list item information (2015)
evidence.says: Show the attribute the user sorted or filtered by; leave out an attribute every result shares.
Users see about the first two words of a list item, so those words carry the information.
